title: Fervo Energy (FRVO) IPO Investors: Kahn Swick & Foti Alerts Shareholders to Class Action — Lead Plaintiff Deadline January 19, 2027
text: Fervo Energy Company (FRVO) Investors Have Opportunity to Lead Securities Lawsuit...
fullText:
NEW YORK and NEW ORLEANS, Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC ("KSF"), whose partners include former Louisiana Attorney General Charles C. Foti, Jr., reminds investors that a class action has been filed against Fervo Energy Company (NasdaqGS: FRVO) on behalf of persons and entities that purchased or otherwise acquired Fervo common stock pursuant and/or traceable to the registration statement for its May 2026 initial public offering (“IPO”).

Key Facts

Case: Nikolov v. Fervo Energy Company, et al., No. 26-cv-10141 (S.D. Tex.)

Claims: Sections 11 and 15 of the Securities Act of 1933

Offering: May 2026 IPO at $27.00 per share, raising about $2.2 billion

Lead plaintiff deadline: January 19, 2027

The complaint alleges that Fervo's IPO registration statement failed to disclose problems with production temperatures and thermal decline at its pilot plant, water loss, drilling costs, and transmission capacity to deliver power to California customers. According to the complaint, an October 6, 2026 Morpheus Research report raised these issues, and Fervo's stock later closed as low as $7.79 per share, more than 71% below the IPO price.

Investors who have since sold their shares may still have a claim. Investors need not serve as lead plaintiff to share in any recovery.

Fervo investors should contact KSF Managing Partner Lewis Kahn toll-free at 1-833-538-3616 or via email (lewis.kahn@ksfcounsel.com), or visit https://www.ksfcounsel.com/cases/nasdaqgs-frvo/ to learn more. There is no cost or obligation.
